title: Family's in town. Show them the bayou.
why: Thanksgiving-visitor carousel for Houston hosts; positions the bayou as the thing visiting family never saw.
hook_options: Show your relatives the Houston they missed
Four days of family. Two hours on the bayou.
caption: Family in town for Thanksgiving? Skip the mall loop. Launch from Allen's Landing, where Houston started, and show them the bayou. Tandems for the nervous ones, kids 6 and up welcome with an adult. #houstonthanksgiving #buffalobayou #buffalobayoukayak #houstonthingstodo

slides.headline: Family's in town. Show them the bayou.
slides.body: Four days, one couch, the same parade. Two hours on Buffalo Bayou beats round three of leftovers.

slides.headline: Mall, museum, more pie
slides.body: Visiting family sees Houston through a windshield. Then they fly home thinking there's nothing here.

slides.headline: Launch where Houston started
slides.body: Allen's Landing, downtown, where the city was founded in 1836. Your relatives will want that fact for dinner.

slides.headline: "Only in Houston for the day"
slides.body: She was in town for one day. The host "took the time to recommend places for us to check out around the area."

slides.headline: Tandems for the nervous ones
slides.body: Put the hesitant relative up front with a steady paddler in back. Kids 6 and up ride with an adult.

slides.headline: Guided skyline tour or rent and roam
slides.body: Two hours with a guide and Houston history, or grab a rental and paddle your own route.

slides.headline: November is made for this
slides.body: Mild afternoons, softer light, no July sweat. Herons and turtles are common, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Skip the lines. Paddle instead.
slides.body: Most of the family is off the day after Thanksgiving. Spend it outside, not circling a parking garage.

slides.headline: Book before the relatives land
slides.body: Lock a time early, then tell everyone it's already handled. Fewer debates at the table.

slides.kicker: Send this to the family group chat
slides.headline: Show them the Houston they missed
slides.body: Tours and rentals from Allen's Landing. Book at buffalobayoukayak.com.
